title: X is adding its first-ever parental controls

claims.claim: X, 13 ila 17 yaş arası çocuklar için ilk kez ebeveyn kontrolleri getirdiğini duyurdu.

evidence.quote: Elon Musk's X has finally introduced parental controls for kids aged 13 to 17, allowing parents and guardians to manage their teen's experience on the platform.

After 20 years of existence, X, the social network formerly known as Twitter, has finally added parental controls for teenagers, giving parents and guardians a way to manage what their kids see and interact with on the platform.
After 20 years of existence, X, the social network formerly known as Twitter, has finally added parental controls for teenagers

claims.claim: Gençlerin hesapları artık hassas medyanın kısıtlandığı ve hedefli reklamların engellendiği korumalı modda varsayılan olarak başlatılacak.

evidence.quote: Teens' accounts will now default to protected mode, with sensitive media restricted and targeted advertising blocked.
The company said accounts belonging to 13-to-17-year-olds will be set to “protected mode” by default, meaning they won’t be able to see sensitive content, and won’t be served targeted ads.

claims.claim: X platformu, kullanıcıların en az 13 yaşında olması gerektiğini veya kanunların gerektirdiği yaş sınırına uymasını şart koştuğunu belirtti.

evidence.quote: While X is not designed for or promoted to children, and users must be at least 13 or older where required by law, we take extra care with the young people who are here
The platform itself requires users to be at least 13 years old, though that’s not a high bar given the kind of content on the platform.
"While X is not designed for or promoted to children, and users must be at least 13 or older where required by law, we take extra care with the young people who are here," the company wrote.

claims.claim: Ebeveynler ve vasiler en fazla beş gence ait hesabı kontrol edebilecek.

evidence.quote: Parents will be able to control up to five teens' accounts.

claims.claim: Ebeveynler, çocuklarının özel mesajlarını okuyamayacak, arama veya izleme geçmişini göremeyecek.

evidence.quote: Parents and guardians cannot read private messages, see searches or viewing history, post as their teen, or access the account
Parents and guardians will also not be able to read their teens’ private messages, see search or viewing history, or post as their teen.

claims.claim: Yeni araçlar sayesinde yetişkinler, çocuklarının X'te ne kadar zaman geçirdiğini görebilecek ve günlük bir sınır belirleyebilecek.

evidence.quote: Those extra tools let adults in charge of teens see how much time their kids have spent on X and set a daily limit
The controls let parents see how much time their teen spends on X per week, set daily limits

claims.claim: Hesapların bağlanması işleminin ebeveyn veya vasi tarafından başlatılıp genç tarafından tamamlanması ve her iki kullanıcının da onay vermesi gerekiyor.

evidence.quote: Linking starts with the parent or guardian and finishes with the teen. Both users have to agree
"Linking starts with the parent or guardian and finishes with the teen. Both users have to agree," the platform states.
